name: promo
description: Cuts the showcase takes into the landing video of the README

scripts.render: bun run render:wide && bun run render:portrait
scripts.render:wide: remotion render Showcase out/showcase.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 && remotion render ShowcaseHero out/hero.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 && scripts/gif.sh
scripts.render:portrait: remotion render ShowcasePortrait out/showcase-portrait.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 && remotion render ShowcasePortraitHero out/portrait-hero.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 && scripts/gif.sh out/portrait-hero.mp4 out/showcase-portrait-hero.gif 320 15
